notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2
notes.notes:
Optimization greatly improved.
Added natural night light.
Various design and gameplay adjustments.
Download size reduced to 900 MB.


Details:

- Now there is natural night light in the game. With this, vision without flashlight improved in outside areas.
- Big building's look and design (slightly) changed. This and some unnoticable changes about big building improved optimization.
- Game's playable area (landscape) size reduced. Players don't have to walk unnecessary long distances anymore.
- View Distance adjusted. View distance of trees, rocks and grasses is now fixed for all settings. With this change, everyone will experience foliage design the same way without impacting game's performance.
- Static lights of the game now deliver better lighting.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1
notes.notes:
Optimization greatly improved.
 Various gameplay adjustments.


Details:

- General optimization of the game improved. But depend on how far your system is to Recommended Specs, you may still want to reduce Graphics Settings in game options menu. Since game starts itself on Ultra Quality.
- Character's sprint limit/exhaust system adjusted.
- A visible puzzle hint added.
- Other minor hints added.
